deliverable: Canonical hypothesis-agnostic performance-tearsheet tooling (library + template + CLI + tests) and the first rendered instance (H107 EMA_9 k1.0)
mechanism: audit-remediate-loop, parallel-Agent fallback (not the Workflow engine); 2 specialist branches (code-reviewer, quant-auditor) + each branch's adversarial refute step; converged round 1, all findings remediated.

findings.summary: drawdown/MaxDD/Calmar referenced the first-bar close, not the 1.0 inception, excluding a first-session loss from drawdown.
findings.remediation: drawdown() and mc_cone maxdd now prepend 1.0 to the equity path before cummax; test_drawdown_captures_first_session_loss added.

findings.summary: profit_factor computed on log-return sums, not the canonical simple-return gross-profit/gross-loss.
findings.remediation: profit_factor now = sum(expm1(r)[>0]) / |sum(expm1(r)[<0])|; test expectation updated to 2.045556.

findings.summary: Sortino guarded to 0.0 on zero downside, colliding with a genuinely poor value.
findings.remediation: returns +inf when dsd==0 and mean>0 (round_floats -> None -> template '—'); test updated to math.isinf.

findings.summary: iid MC docstring did not state the directional consequence of discarding serial dependence.
findings.remediation: module + mc_cone docstrings now state the iid resampling understates cone/maxdd risk under positive autocorrelation.

clean_checks: _ninjatrader_variants isolates the E-mini parent (no MES/ES swap)

findings.summary: _screen_cell read sd['dsr_bound'] directly; grid_screen._dsr_block omits it on a degenerate cell -> KeyError crashes the whole build.
findings.remediation: all construction-dependent s_d fields read via .get(); degenerate cell renders 'degenerate (no bound)' / '—' instead of crashing.

findings.summary: template carried no Content-Security-Policy; a standalone file:// report had no script-source/egress enforcement.
findings.remediation: template is now a complete HTML document with a meta CSP (default-src 'none'; connect-src 'none'; script-src cdnjs + 'unsafe-inline'; style/font from Google Fonts; img data:/self).

findings.summary: args.title substituted into <title> unescaped; __TITLE__ replaced before __DATA__.
no finite-guard on the gross/cost panel (a ruin -inf row would become a silent null).
findings.remediation: SystemExit naming the offending session_date(s) if gross/cost not all finite, matching grid_screen's contract.
hoisted to the top import block.

findings.summary: bare exhibit constants (n_mc/cone_points/bins/downsample/seed) lacked a # justify note.
findings.remediation: lifted to named module constants with a # justify block (diagnostic-resolution rationale; seed mirrors run_screen_h107).

refuted_dropped.refutation: the contract != symbol clause provably excludes micros; E-mini parent isolated.

refuted_dropped.claim: turnover reconstruction diverges from the screen
refuted_dropped.refutation: the /2.0 half-notional drag and median-reference-price construction are byte-identical across build_tearsheet and grid_screen.

verification.regeneration: H107 instance reproduces ES -77.2%/Sharpe -0.855, NQ -23.9%/-0.126 after fixes (MaxDD stable; first-session not the worst DD)
verification.html: generated report has DOCTYPE + CSP, parses, closes body/html; app JS node --check OK

residual_risks: The MC cone is an iid path-reshuffle; under serial dependence it understates risk (now documented; a stationary-block variant per Politis-Romano 1994 is a possible future option, not implemented).

CR-1-2 CSP uses script-src 'unsafe-inline' for the page's own inline bootstrap (no hash/nonce) — acceptable for a trusted self-generated file with the title escaped and the JSON non-executable; default-src/connect-src 'none' still block all egress.

Sampling caveat: two specialist branches (code quality, statistical-formula fidelity) at effort default via the parallel-Agent fallback; critical-reviewer / scope-auditor / reproducibility branches were not run (the tooling emits no ReproLog — it is a diagnostic renderer, not an artifact-producing inference run). Where no empirical check applied (the HTML contract, magic-number style), the refute gate ran without an empirical backstop.
